title: Dev bug: NS profiles are overwritten with local profile
body:
This is with DASH-AIMI code (build 0e4a6579e) on S20 but is thought to apply more broadly to aaps main dev.

Before this aaps version, I had previously used NS profiles, and had several profiles in NS. This aaps version only allows for local profile (fine for dev purposes). So I set up a local profile to use it. BUT now that seems to have deleted all the profiles I had in NS - all that is visible in NS is a new 'LocalProfile'.

Aaps shouldn’t be deleting previous profiles stored in ns.

comments.body: This happened to me as well.

you can allow/disable profile sync with NS.
If you have enabled advanced profiles (in NS) you can always revert to previous profiles because AAPS always creates new record with profiles in NS on update

Many thanks for quick & helpful reply Milos. I can see old profiles in NS by selecting older database records as you say - good they are not lost. 

I have profile sync off though in aaps, so hadn't expected the aaps local profile to be uploaded to ns.

Many thanks

i updated AAPS to sync profiles with NS in setup wizard
